Date: January 14th

Dear Ms. Moore,
I would like to attend the upcoming Teach With Us conference in Chicago, Illinois, on February 1st.

The conference theme is Teaching in the 21st Century and it is the premier event for teaching professionals. This year's conference centers on digital teaching resources and using other online methods, which are pertinent to what we are publishing right now. The conference also features many world-renowned publishers and motivational talks that would be of great benefit to my work. In addition, workshops will include discussions with best-selling authors and consultants on the front lines of the publishing industry.

The networking I will do with the conference attendees will prove invaluable. It will give me the opportunity to get out of the office and meet colleagues from around the world! It is the perfect place to learn what others in our industry are doing and how they're doing it. I would also like to organize a private consultation with a senior executive from PubWorld in order to discuss the design of our upcoming projects spearheaded by Lincoln Green. They are highly regarded for redefining magazine layouts, as seen at the recent unveiling of Cosmalian Magazine. The website detailing the conference can be found at www.epublica.cam. I have been following the live stream so as to keep up to date with planned events. There is considerable buzz about the conference!
The cost for attending the conference is significant. Over and above the cost of the registration fee, there are also travel expenses. These will include flights, hotel, and meals. I would also hope to attend the dinner so as to network as much as possible. The total cost for the conference is $2100 USD. An itemized account is listed below.

Conference Fee: $250
Gala Dinner Event: $250
Airfare: $800 return
Hotel: $500
Meals: $300
Total : $2100
I am confident you will agree that this investment is worthwhile. I will be networking with the industry's best and will attend invaluable educational sessions. I would be able to meet and share ideas with colleagues from around the world. Further, I will use this opportunity for the betterment of the company.
Sincerely,
Adam Bari

Purpose Clauses: in order to and so as to

There are a variety of ways to express purpose. The most common way is to use an infinitive of purpose (to + verb). You can use other phrases and expressions to introduce a purpose clause. Varying the structures you use when you are speaking or writing can be beneficial in making you appear more professional.
You can use the phrases in order to and so as to to introduce the reason for actions or situations.
In order to
This is a formal way of presenting the reason for something.

For example:
I called a meeting in order to discuss funding for the conference.

You can choose to use so as to as well.
This is another formal phrase you can use to introduce a reason clause.

For example:
I am attending the conference so as to network with other like-minded people.
You often use in order to and so as to after stative verbs like know, seem and appear.

For example:
He dressed in a dark suit at the meeting in order to/so as to appear more serious.
I am networking so as to meet new people in my field.
I am attending the seminar in order to learn more about the product.
We are meeting the client in order to get some more information about their concerns.
They are leaving now so as not to be late.
How to Write a Funding Request Letter

You may have an opportunity to attend conferences during your career. You can write a request letter for funding to pay for the trip. It may cover the cost of meals, accommodation, flights and associated fees.
A strong letter that provides detailed information about the conference and the benefits of your attendance for you and your company is essential.
They should include a formal greeting and closing.
State how attending the conference will benefit the company.
As you learn more, you do more. Your skill set will be enhanced.
Advancement from within. The company may be able to hire internally in the future.
Your new skills will make you more productive at work.
You will be able to take on additional assignments.
You will be able to increase your leadership skills and take on more responsibility.
